meta.title: Bramble Basket
meta.instructions: Drag the basket left and right to catch falling berries. Gold berries are worth five. Dodge the spiky burrs: three pricks and the picnic is over. Last 45 seconds and keep a streak going for bonus points.

in_basket.body: d.kind != 'burr' and abs(d.x - player.x) < 36.0 and abs(d.y - (player.y - 8.0)) < 22.0

mult.body: if streak >= 15 then 3 else if streak >= 6 then 2 else 1

let.kind: if roll < 0.22 + 0.2 * difficulty then 'burr' else if roll > 0.93 then 'gold' else 'berry'

do.value: {id: seq, x: random_float(40.0, 320.0), y: 96.0, vy: 150.0 + 150.0 * difficulty + random_float(0.0, 50.0), kind: kind, spin: random_float(-120.0, 120.0)}

do.to: map(drops, d => {...d, y: d.y + d.vy * event.dt / 1000.0})

do.where: d => d.kind == 'burr' and dist(vec(d.x, d.y), hit_at) < 60.0

node.visible: = now - cheer_at < 1200 and not starts_with(cheer, 'Ouch') and status == 'playing'
= now - cheer_at < 1200 and starts_with(cheer, 'Ouch') and status == 'playing'

node.eyebrow: = if status == 'won' then 'PICNIC SAVED' else 'PRICKED THREE TIMES'
node.title: = if status == 'won' then 'A basket full of berries' else 'The burrs got you'

score.measures: berry points caught before the 45 seconds run out

art.style: A picnic meadow at golden hour: pale mint sky, rolling green hills, a woven willow basket, plump violet berries, rare gold berries and spiky brown burrs.
